description: Return the full record for one event: the long description, every booking link its page carries, the stay link where present, and the page URLs in every published language. For classified events the result also includes event_class, the site's own browse-to-book class, and availability, the availability line the event page itself carries, word for word. Japan events carry Japan's classes (A: tickets bookable online; B: ticketed, sold through the organiser's official channels, not on the site; C: free and unticketed, travel-worthy; D: free and unticketed, local; E: ticketing handled by the organiser, unproven either way). Events from the other What's On sites carry that site's own class word: ticketed (a verified ticket product is sold through the page's booking link), official (tickets are sold by the organiser's official seller, linked from the page), free (free entry, no ticket needed), or listed (the site does not sell tickets for this event; the availability line says how to attend). Events whose site does not classify them return event_class and availability as null. Ended events are returned flagged ended: true with their dates, never presented as upcoming. Look the event up by the id returned by search_events or whats_on, or by its canonical page URL. This server is read-only: it takes no bookings, and prices and availability are confirmed on the merchant's site.

id.description: The event id returned by search_events or whats_on, for example "hong-kong-new-year-countdown-2026".

page_url.description: The canonical event page URL, as an alternative to id.

name: event_details
title: Full details for one event
